AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Verified administrator identity record mapped to Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

AllowedUser.title: AllowedUser
AllowedUser.description: Authorized friend or collaborator granted access to SKI PILOT.

label.description: Short display label for the invited friend.

role.description: Access tier assigned to the user.

UserPrefs.title: UserPrefs
UserPrefs.description: Per-user private preferences including configurable departure label.

departureLabel.description: Custom departure city or region label shown only after login.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last preference update.

SharedDatasetMeta.description: Singleton metadata coordinating cloud-synced ski stations and snow history across devices.

snowFileName.description: Optional source filename for snow records.

snowChunkCount.description: Number of snow_* documents in shared_chunks.

lastArchiveCatchupAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest Open-Meteo Archive backfill.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud sync.

SharedDatasetChunk.description: Bounded chunk of station records or daily snow records for multi-device synchronization.

kind.description: Type of records stored in this chunk.

items.description: Bounded array of station or snow record objects.

updatedByUid.description: Auth UID of the administrator who wrote this chunk.

/allowed_users/{inviteId}.description: Allowlist of authorized Google accounts keyed by sanitized email ID.
